name: MUSIC BOX I - Liebestraum
source:
While cutting through the garden of a deserted house to get to college one morning, Randall stumbles upon an old music box. As the tune begins to play, a love story begins to unfold.

[From [url=https://linxuelian.itch.io/vn-music-box-i-liebestraum]Itch.io[/url]]
